question: The expression \(a^3-a^{-3}\) equals:
solution:
The expression requires \(a\ne0\). Since \(a^{-3}=(1/a)^3\), it is a difference of two cubes. Use
\[
u^3-v^3=(u-v)(u^2+uv+v^2)
\]
with \(u=a\) and \(v=1/a\). Their product is \(uv=1\), so
\[
a^3-a^{-3}
=\left(a-\frac1a\right)
\left(a^2+1+\frac1{a^2}\right).
\]
This identity holds for every \(a\ne0\), giving choice A.
